scenario_checks.question: Attribution selects the latest eligible preceding touch
scenario_checks.sql: SELECT a.id,t.id FROM attributions a JOIN conversions c ON c.id=a.conversion_id JOIN touchpoints t ON t.id=a.touchpoint_id JOIN attribution_rules r ON r.id=a.rule_id LEFT JOIN touchpoints x ON x.profile_id=c.profile_id AND x.event_day>t.event_day AND x.event_day<=c.event_day AND c.event_day-x.event_day<=r.window_days WHERE t.event_day<=c.event_day AND c.event_day-t.event_day<=r.window_days AND x.id IS NULL

scenario_checks.question: Two campaign touches precede purpose withdrawal and later conversion
scenario_checks.sql: SELECT p.id,COUNT(DISTINCT t.id),e.purpose,e.status FROM profiles p JOIN touchpoints t ON t.profile_id=p.id JOIN consents c ON c.profile_id=p.id JOIN consent_events e ON e.consent_id=c.id JOIN conversions v ON v.profile_id=p.id WHERE v.event_day>5 GROUP BY p.id,e.purpose,e.status

scenario_checks.question: Consent purpose links to source identity, session and attributed merge evidence
scenario_checks.sql: SELECT c.purpose,i.publisher,a.status FROM consents c JOIN source_identities i ON i.id=c.source_identity_id JOIN sessions s ON s.source_identity_id=i.id JOIN identity_assertions a ON a.left_id=i.id

scenario_checks.question: Find conversions outside the selected window
scenario_checks.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM conversions c JOIN touchpoints t ON t.profile_id=c.profile_id JOIN attribution_rules r WHERE c.event_day-t.event_day>r.window_days

scenario_checks.question: Outside-window conversion stays unattributed
scenario_checks.sql: SELECT conversion_id FROM attributions WHERE touchpoint_id IS NULL

scenario_checks.question: Consent includes channel and validity interval
scenario_checks.sql: SELECT channel_id,status,valid_to FROM consents
